summary: Practise privacy assessments, rights workflows and incident records across GDPR, CCPA and HIPAA. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Data privacy and protection training helps practitioners map personal information and assess how it is collected, used, shared and stored. Designed for privacy analysts, managers and compliance or security officers, it addresses maintaining processing records and coordinating rights requests and incident response. Learners practise mapping data flows, assessing risks and vendor safeguards, and documenting retention, deletion and remediation actions.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for practitioners who maintain privacy controls, advise on data uses, or coordinate responses involving personal information and protected health information.
prerequisites: Prior experience in privacy, data protection, compliance, information security or a related operational role is expected. Familiarity with personal information or protected health information workflows will help you apply the exercises.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
